bias.zh: 反弹 · 跌破 $350，位于 30 日均线上方

read.en: Broadcom fell 4.8% on Nov 13 to $347.01, trading $337.67–358.47. It is above the 5-day ($341.6), 10-day ($327.3) and 30-day ($339.6) and below the 100-day ($364.7) and 200-day ($367.4); the 5, 10 and 200-day are rising. MACD has been above its signal since Nov 11, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 11 ($294.26), and RSI is 53.2.
read.zh: 博通 11月13日下跌 4.8%，收于 $347.01，盘中区间 $337.67–358.47。股价位于 5 日（$341.6）、10 日（$327.3）和 30 日均线（$339.6）上方，100 日（$364.7）和 200 日均线（$367.4）下方；5 日、10 日和 200 日均线在上行。MACD 自 11月11日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月11日起看多（$294.26），RSI 为 53.2。

read.en: The pullback lost the $350.1–356.9 support (Aug 26 low, Nov 11 high), now resistance; the $337.67 low held near the 30-day. Resistance is $350.1–358.5 (Nov 13 high), then $364.4–369.8 (100 and 200-day, Nov 12 high) and $376.6 (Aug 28 high). Support is $337.7–344.3 (30 and 5-day, Nov 11 low), then $327.3–334.7 and $316.7–319.5. A close above $358.5 would target $365–370; below $337.7, $327–335.

r.en: Aug 26 low $350.06; Nov 11 high $356.85, lost; Nov 13 high $358.47
